{"sample_id":"arvo_18066",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
    "line":96,"var":"exp_src","code":"std::string exp_src = exp->to_string();",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"First argument ')' is converted to string for selector parsing, producing input that will parse to an empty SelectorList"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
    "line":97,"var":"sel","code":"SelectorListObj sel = Parser::parse_selector(exp_src.c_str(), ctx, traces, exp->pstate(), pstate.src, true);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Parsing ')' as a selector; parseSelectorList breaks immediately because ')' matches selector_list_delims, returning an empty SelectorList with zero elements"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
    "line":127,"var":"parsedSelectors","code":"parsedSelectors.push_back(sel);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Empty SelectorList pushed as first resolved selector (sel_0) in parsedSelectors stack"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
    "line":122,"var":"sel","code":"parsedSelectors.push_back(sel->resolve_parent_refs(parsedSelectors, traces, true));",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Second arg '&' calls resolve_parent_refs with parsedSelectors containing the empty sel_0 as parent"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/ast_selectors.cpp","function":"ComplexSelector::resolve_parent_refs",
    "line":956,"var":"chroots()","code":"if (!chroots() && parent)",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"chroots() is true (set by selector-append), so parent is NOT pushed to vars; subsequent CompoundSelector returns empty rv because parent->elements() is empty, leaving vars empty"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/ast_selectors.cpp","function":"CompoundSelector::resolve_parent_refs",
    "line":877,"var":"rv","code":"for (auto complex : parent->elements())",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"parent is sel_0 (non-null but empty SelectorList); loop body never executes; rv stays empty; asd.size()==0 so nothing pushed to vars"},
   {"step":7,"file":"src/permutate.hpp","function":"permutateAlt",
    "line":78,"var":"n","code":"size_t n = in.size() - 1;",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"vars (in) is empty (size 0); n = 0-1 = SIZE_MAX due to unsigned underflow; state[n] reads uninitialized memory"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
     "line":96,"operands":["exp_src"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/ast_selectors.cpp","function":"ComplexSelector::resolve_parent_refs",
     "line":956,"operands":["vars.size()","0"],
     "relation":{"op":"gt","left":"vars.size()","right":"0"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/permutate.hpp","function":"permutateAlt",
     "line":78,"operands":["in.size()","1"],
     "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"in.size()","right":"1"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
       "line":96,"operands":["exp_src"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
       "line":127,"operands":["parsedSelectors"]},
      "type":"data","via":["sel"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"sel->elements().size()","right":"0"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/fn_selectors.cpp","function":"selector_append",
       "line":127,"operands":["parsedSelectors"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/ast_selectors.cpp","function":"ComplexSelector::resolve_parent_refs",
       "line":956,"operands":["parent"]},
      "type":"data","via":["pstack.back()"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/ast_selectors.cpp","function":"CompoundSelector::resolve_parent_refs",
       "line":877,"operands":["rv"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/permutate.hpp","function":"permutateAlt",
       "line":78,"operands":["in"]},
      "type":"data","via":["vars"]}
   ]
 }}
